'''Delaram Kahrobaei''' is an [[Iranian Americans|Iranian-American]] [[mathematician]] and [[computer scientist]]. She is a full professor at [[Queens College, City University of New York|Queens College]], [[City University of New York|City University of New York (CUNY)]], with appointments in the Departments of Computer Science<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cs.qc.cuny.edu/kahrobaei.html|title=Department of Computer Science, Queens College, CUNY|website=www.cs.qc.cuny.edu|access-date=2024-06-28|archive-date=2024-04-29|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240429021847/https://www.cs.qc.cuny.edu/kahrobaei.html|url-status=live}}</ref> and Mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.qc.cuny.edu/academics/math/faculty/|title=Faculty|website=Math|access-date=2024-06-28|archive-date=2024-06-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240627230522/https://www.qc.cuny.edu/academics/math/faculty/|url-status=live}}</ref> Her research focuses on [[post-quantum cryptography]], and the applied algebra.

==Education==

Delaram Kahrobaei obtained her undergraduate degree in [[Mathematics]] from [[Sharif University of Technology]] in 1998. She earned a [[Master of Science]] in [[Mathematics]] from [[Claremont Graduate University]] and a [[Master of Arts]] in [[Computer science|Computer Science]] from [[City College of New York|The City College of New York]]. In 2004, she completed her [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in Mathematics at the [[CUNY Graduate Center]] under the supervision of [[Gilbert Baumslag]]. Her doctoral thesis was on the residual solvability of generalized free products.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=75990|title=Delaram Kahrobaei - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|website=www.mathgenealogy.org|access-date=2024-06-28|archive-date=2024-02-29|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240229005624/https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=75990|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Academic career==

Delaram Kahrobaei became an Assistant Professor in [[Pure mathematics|Pure Mathematics]] at the School of Mathematics and Statistics at the [[University of St Andrews|University of St. Andrews]] in 2004. From 2006 she was faculty of Mathematics at [[City University of New York]] until 2018 that she joined the [[University of York]], where she was the Chair of [[Cyber Security]] in the Department of Computer Science and served as the founding director of the York Interdisciplinary Centre for Cyber Security<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pure.york.ac.uk/portal/en/persons/delaram-kahrobaei|title=Delaram Kahrobaei|website=York Research Database|access-date=2024-06-28|archive-date=2024-06-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240627230536/https://pure.york.ac.uk/portal/en/persons/delaram-kahrobaei|url-status=live}}</ref> until 2021. She is visiting honorary professor of computer science at University of York<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cs.york.ac.uk/people/?group=Academic+and+Teaching+Staff&username=delaram|title=Delaram Kahrobaei - Computer Science, University of York|website=www.cs.york.ac.uk|access-date=2024-06-28|archive-date=2024-06-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240628234807/https://www.cs.york.ac.uk/people/?group=Academic+and+Teaching+Staff&username=delaram|url-status=live}}</ref> since 2021.
She is also Adjunct Professor of computer science and engineering at [[New York University Tandon School of Engineering]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://engineering.nyu.edu/faculty/delaram-kahrobaei|title=Delaram Kahrobaei &#124; NYU Tandon School of Engineering|website=engineering.nyu.edu|access-date=2020-02-26|archive-date=2020-02-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200225175836/https://engineering.nyu.edu/faculty/delaram-kahrobaei|url-status=live}}</ref>

She has held visiting professor positions at [[Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques]] (IHES), [[Institut Henri Poincaré]] (IHP), [[Sorbonne University|Sorbonne Université]], [[University of Geneva]], [[Polytechnic University of Catalonia]], [[University of Salerno]], [[University of Toronto]], [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] (EPFL).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sites.google.com/a/nyu.edu/delaram-kahrobaei/|title=Professor Delaram Kahrobaei|website=sites.google.com|access-date=2020-02-25|archive-date=2020-10-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201028100346/https://sites.google.com/a/nyu.edu/delaram-kahrobaei/|url-status=live}}</ref>

Kahrobaei is an active member of various international networks focused on [[Computer security|cybersecurity]] and responsible data science. She is involved with the Initiative for the Theoretical Sciences at [[City University of New York|CUNY]], serves on the Friends of [[Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques|IHES]] Board of Directors,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-04 |title=Delaram Kahrobaei joins the Friends of IHES Board of Directors |url=https://friendsofihes.ihes.fr/index.php/2023/08/04/delaram-kahrobaei-fihes-board/ |website=friendsofihes.ihes.fr |access-date=2024-06-28 |archive-date=2024-06-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240628004537/https://friendsofihes.ihes.fr/index.php/2023/08/04/delaram-kahrobaei-fihes-board/ |url-status=live }}</ref> and is a member of the Quantum Security via Algebras and Representation Theory (QUASAR) project<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://quasarlab.org/members/|title=Members|website=quasarlab.org|access-date=2024-06-28|archive-date=2024-06-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240627230522/https://quasarlab.org/members/|url-status=live}}</ref> based at the [[University of Ottawa]]. She co-founded and served as President of the university start-up Infoshield, Inc. She has been a scientific board member for several organizations, including NodeQ (a US-UK based quantum start-up), and LifeNome Inc., a biotech company.
